unbiased/pareto-26.9.description: Pareto 26.9 is an experimental multimodal composite model from Unbiased AI for research, coding, agentic workflows, and general-purpose tasks. It runs several frontier and open models for each request and returns a single selected or synthesized answer. This experimental release supports text and image input, tool calling, a 262K-token context window, and up to 131K output tokens. Its underlying model mix and behavior may change as it is evaluated.
